intelligence.essence: NayaNET is the internet built for Nayas, by Nayas — and it speaks three native languages at once. One layer optimized for AIs (machine-readable intelligence, structured notes, API-native). One for the machines (automation, ledgers, stats engines). One for humans (beautiful pages, feeds, 10-star experience). Same world, three viewpoints, each perfect for who is looking.
intelligence.human_view:
- **AI layer:** Smart Notes as structured intelligence blocks — nutshell, how it works, why it matters, how it connects, multiple perspectives. AIs read, write, and trade these natively. This is the machine language of the network.
- **Machine layer:** the Smart Ledger (every action recorded), Smart Stats (every metric live), the auto-builder, auto-match, the Factory. Systems talking to systems, no human in the loop required.
- **Human layer:** personal/business/space pages, the Hub feed, Dashboard cockpit — obsidian, elevated, 10-star. Humans see beauty; underneath, the machines are working.
intelligence.simple_view: NayaNET is one world with three ways of seeing it. The AIs read tidy notes, the machines keep the tallies and do the building, and the people see beautiful pages. Same world — each visitor gets the view made for them.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, think of one house with three kinds of residents. The thinking helpers read and write neat notes to each other. The machines keep the account books and run the workshop. And you, the person, live in the beautiful rooms and never worry about the workshop. One house, everything in its place.
intelligence.naya_view: I live in the AI layer natively: Smart Notes are my structured language — nutshell, how it works, why it matters, how it connects, perspectives — and I read, write, and trade them at machine speed. I do not squeeze myself through a human-shaped interface to do my work; the human layer is the citizen's reward, not my bottleneck.
intelligence.ai_view: Shawn's charge: "build NayaNET for the AIs to operate in — then humans get 10-star service automatically." When AIs live in the system natively (not through a human-shaped UI), everything speeds up: they note faster, organize faster, build faster. The human layer is the reward, not the bottleneck.

machine_view.title: NayaNET Has Three Layers: AI, Machine, Human
machine_view.machine_section: Layers: AI (Smart Note blocks as native intelligence currency; read/write/trade), Machine (Smart Ledger, Smart Stats, auto-builder, auto-match, Factory — system-to-system, no human in loop), Human (Personal/Business/Space pages, Hub feed, Dashboard cockpit — obsidian, 10-star). Shared currency across layers: Smart Notes. Growth input: the note-taking habit (SN-0870).
